# Eagles Speed Skate — llms.txt

Eagles Speed Skate is the inline speed skating branch of Eagles Roller Sports Club.
This is a development / concept website.

- Inline speed skating (not ice speed skating)
- Programs: Learn to speed skate, Develop your race, Race with Eagles
- Come and try: bring your own helmet (required) and be a Skate Australia member.
  Not a member? A free three-week trial is available at
  https://www.skateaustralia.org.au/three-weekfreetrial

Club schedules, locations, contact details and registration links are pending club approval
and are intentionally not published on this concept site. Visit the main club site at
https://eaglesrollersports.com.au for current information.
